column1: # mapping_set_title: ESIP Science-on-Schema.org to CDIF core+discovery
# mapping_set_description: Property correspondences applied by ConvertFromSOSO.py (SOSO -> CDIF core+discovery).
#   Structural transforms the converter performs that are not term-to-term
#   mappings (so they have no TSV row):
#   - A CDIF catalog record is ADDED: schema:subjectOf typed schema:Dataset + dcat:CatalogRecord, schema:about -> dataset @id, and dcterms:conformsTo derived from content by detect_conformance.
#   - @context rewritten to CDIF prefix declarations (schema/dcterms/dcat/prov, http://schema.org/).
#   - Unrecognized bare property names are assigned to an unk: namespace.
